semiconductor_relevance: High — Mitutoyo Taiwan specializes in precision measurement solutions that are critical for quality control and process efficiency in semiconductor manufacturing.

Their Quick Vision Active series offers advanced measurement capabilities suitable for various industries, including electronics.
